name: Neighborhood Guide
controllingIdea: Every neighborhood has a story worth telling.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: There is a neighborhood people keep asking about
narrativeArc.risingAction: Explore the dining, lifestyle, convenience, and commute data
narrativeArc.crisis: Most agents describe areas with vague adjectives - you bring receipts
narrativeArc.climax: The real numbers paint a picture no listing description can match
narrativeArc.resolution: This community is calling - the question is whether you will answer

triggerMoments.moment: Buyers keep asking about a specific area

questions.question: What neighborhood or community are you featuring?
questions.purpose: Identify the area and fetch location data
questions.placeholder: Winter Park, FL or College Park, Orlando

questions.question: Why do people love living here?
questions.purpose: Capture the community's identity and appeal
questions.placeholder: Tree-lined streets, locally owned shops, Saturday farmers market...

questions.question: What surprises people about this area?
questions.placeholder: Most people don't realize you're 20 minutes to the beach, or that there are 30+ restaurants on Park Ave...

questions.question: What type of resident thrives in this community?
questions.purpose: Help viewers self-identify with the area
questions.placeholder: Families who want top schools and walkability, retirees looking for culture...

questions.question: What is your favorite personal spot or ritual here?
questions.placeholder: Every Sunday morning at Barnie's Coffee, then a walk around Lake Baldwin...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is a community-focused area guide. Use Life Here location intelligence when available to add real data points. Position the agent as the local expert. Focus on community character, not just amenities. This is about selling a lifestyle and neighborhood, not a specific property.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Warm, knowledgeable, proud. Sound like someone who genuinely knows and loves this area. Mix data with personal experience. Be specific - name real places, real numbers, real experiences.

slideStructure.contentFocus: What makes this neighborhood feel different
Life Here scores, dining count, park count
What a typical day or weekend looks like
What most people don't know about this area
Want my full neighborhood guide? Let's connect.

usageHints: Best for agents who farm a specific neighborhood
Use Life Here data when an address or area center point is available
Can be repurposed seasonally with different angles
Great for building local authority and attracting area-specific leads

exampleScenarios.title: Winter Park Community Guide
exampleScenarios.situation: Agent farms Winter Park and wants to create a neighborhood showcase
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: Winter Park is all about the tree-lined streets, Park Ave boutiques, and Saturday farmers market. 40+ restaurants, great schools, 25 min to the airport. Families and young professionals love it here.

expectedOutput.hook: Winter Park is not a suburb. It is a lifestyle.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: 40+ restaurants on Park Ave. Top-rated schools. 25 minutes to MCO. This is the real Central Florida.
